memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and rheumatoid arthritis are present.
Patient reports aching knee pain worsening with stairs, mild morning stiffness in hands lasting <30 min, and occasional fatigue. Examination shows tenderness and mild effusion of both knees, no joint warmth, liver not enlarged, hands show mild synovitis without deformity. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking status: never. Weight 68 kg, BMI 22.1.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past two weeks my knees have felt more sore after walking to the market, and I notice stiffness in my fingers when I wake up. I’ve been taking the paracetamol as needed but it only helps a little. My appetite is fine and I haven’t noticed any new abdominal discomfort.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees, NAFLD, and rheumatoid arthritis remain stable.
Patient reports knee pain now only on prolonged walking, morning hand stiffness improved to <15 min, fatigue less noticeable. Examination: mild tenderness of knees, no effusion, hands show minimal synovitis. Liver edge not palpable. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking status: never. Weight stable 68 kg.

memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray of both knees: joint space narrowing medial compartment bilaterally, modest osteophyte formation, no subchondral cyst or fracture. Impression: moderate osteoarthritis changes.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Lately I’ve felt a dull ache in my right knee even at rest, and I’ve noticed a bit of swelling around the joint. My fingers still feel stiff in the mornings but it’s not worse. I haven’t had any new abdominal pain or jaundice.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees progressed mildly; NAFLD unchanged; rheumatoid arthritis well controlled.
Patient reports increased right knee discomfort at rest with occasional swelling, morning hand stiffness ~10 min, fatigue minimal. Examination: mild effusion and warmth of right knee, left knee tender without effusion, hands show minimal synovitis. Liver not enlarged. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking status: never. Weight 69 kg.

memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees stable with symptomatic management; NAFLD unchanged; rheumatoid arthritis in remission.
Patient reports right knee ache only after prolonged standing, no swelling, morning hand stiffness <5 min, no fatigue. Examination: mild tenderness of knees, no effusion or warmth, hands normal. Liver not palpable. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking status: never. Weight 68 kg.
